fields.name: DbParameterExtensions typed output-value getters
fields.contract: DbParameterExtensions reads a populated DbParameter value through one typed getter family. For nullable and reference-value targets (string, byte[], JsonDocument, and nullable Int64, Int32, Int16, Byte, Boolean, Decimal, Double, Single, Guid, DateTime, DateTimeOffset, TimeSpan, DateOnly, and TimeOnly), a DBNull value is represented as null. For required floating-point targets, a DBNull value is represented as NaN; for required Guid, it is represented as Guid.Empty. A non-DBNull value of the selected target type is returned without changing it, including Guid.Empty. Required integer, Boolean, Decimal, temporal, DateOnly, and TimeOnly targets have a separate required-value failure policy recorded for cross-cutting review.
